data_section_full_text:
Our sample consists of 24,592 firm-year observations (including 1,315
 that use IAS) from 1999 to 2002 in 29 countries. We obtain our mutual fund
 holdings data from the Thomson Financial Services (TFS) international
 mutual fund database, a fairly new database in the literature.
